subject: Follow-up: encryption & logging clarifications from today's call
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@finpay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: encryption & logging clarifications from today's call

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so our engineering team can size the pilot and draft a short ops runbook for you. TL;DR: Redwood supports both hosted and private deployments; we can offer customer-managed keys (BYOK/CMK) with HSM-backed keys, and we have configurable request/response logging and retention controls. A couple of specifics we need from your side to finalize the proposal: 

- KMS model: do you prefer vendor KMS (Redwood-managed) or customer-managed (you provide KMS/HSM)? If CMK, which cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) or on-prem HSM will you use?
- Key custody: is split custody or dual-control required (FIPS/HSM attestation)?
- Log retention: target retention window for inference request/response metadata and full payloads (if any) — e.g., 90 days vs 1 year vs 7 years for audit.
- Redaction/reset: do you require automatic PII redaction for logs at ingest, or will you review and redact on your side?
- Access & audit: list of roles that need read access to logs (Security/Legal/Support).
- Compliance evidence: do you need HSM attestation copies, KMS key usage logs, and/or signed export of audit logs for SOC2/ISO?

Attached is a short options summary (redwood_kms_options.pdf) and an example logging-retention-schema.xlsx that maps what we can provide.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the KMS model + retention window.
2) We'll schedule a 60-minute ops workshop with our infra engineer (Dev) and product (Marcus) to validate network/VPC needs and produce a pilot runbook.
3) We deliver a one-page SOW + pilot timeline.

Would Thursday 10–11am PT work for the workshop?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference

Attachments: redwood_kms_options.pdf (PDF summary), logging-retention-schema.xlsx (Excel sample)

From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@finpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@finpay.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption & logging clarifications from today's call

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the recap and the helpful attachments. A few answers inline: 

- KMS model: We'd prefer customer-managed keys hosted in our AWS account (AWS KMS with an external HSM module).
- Key custody: Yes — dual-control for key export is required. We need HSM (FIPS 140-2 level 3 or equivalent) attestation for any hardware involved.
- Log retention: For request/response metadata we want 1 year. For full payloads that may contain PII, retention should be 90 days unless redaction is applied.
- Redaction/reset: We prefer automatic PII redaction at ingest by Redwood where possible; otherwise we will handle it, but it needs to be configurable by route/model.
- Access & audit: Security team (security@finpay.com) + Legal (legal@finpay.com) need read-only access to sanitized logs; Support will have access to metadata only.
- Compliance evidence: We will require KMS usage logs (key IDs, timestamps), HSM attestation, and exportable audit logs for the pilot.

We can do the ops workshop on Thursday 10–11am PT. Procurement will want the SOW + estimated monthly committed spend ahead of signature.

I will share a short internal note to procurement to ensure they're looped in.

Best,
Lena Brooks
Head of Platform Security — FinPay
Lena.Brooks@finpay.com | +1 (212) 555-4356

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@finpay.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption & logging clarifications from today's call

Hi Lena —

Quick technical notes ahead of the workshop so you have what to expect: 

- AWS KMS CMK: We support AWS KMS keys and can integrate with your account via cross-account grants. For HSM-backed keys, Redwood supports wrapping keys with a CloudHSM cluster or customer HSM via a KMIP gateway. Dual-control (split roles for key export) is supported using our key ceremony flow; we can provide the runbook.
- Transport encryption: TLS 1.3 mandatory for all in-transit traffic; mTLS available for private endpoints.
- At-rest: model weights and cache can be encrypted with the CMK; per-customer envelope keys are standard.
- Log choices: 
  * Metadata logs (request IDs, model, token counts, response latency) — stored for 1 year by default (configurable).
  * Payload logging (inputs/outputs) — off by default; can be enabled per-route and retained for 90 days. 
  * Redaction: We support a plugin to strip known PII patterns (SSNs, credit card numbers, email addresses) at ingestion; we can also run a policy-based redactor on demand.
- Evidence: We can provide key usage logs (CloudTrail-compatible), signed HSM attestation PDFs from our partner HSM vendor, and periodic export of sanitized audit logs (CSV/JSON).

I'll bring network and KMS diagrams to Thursday's workshop. Can you confirm the AWS account ID we'll be granting cross-account access to so we can pre-provision the IAM role?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
